attributes.name: css class naming approach
attributes.definition: How the page's CSS classes are named and organized: meaningful content/role-based names versus utility-style or framework classes.

values.definition: A small or modest set of custom classes with meaningful, role-based names (e.g. .card, .hero), written by hand.
Many atomic utility classes (e.g. Tailwind-style) applied directly in markup.
Classes from a UI framework such as Bootstrap-style component classes.
Little to no class usage; styling via element selectors or inline styles.
Another approach, such as CSS-in-JS or generated class names.
